title: Intercompany Elimination and Netting Workflow
description: Deterministic intercompany elimination and netting arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic entity pairs: receivable-versus-payable matching at 2dp half-up rounding, mismatch listing with differences, elimination totals, unmatched residual, and an overall GAPS_FOUND or ALL_MATCHED verdict. Pure matching arithmetic — no posting, no payment, no network, no clock.

pairs.description: Declared intercompany entity pairs: a_receivable is the receivable declared by entity a, b_payable is the payable declared by entity b.

a_receivable.description: Receivable amount declared by a; finite, non-negative.

b_payable.description: Payable amount declared by b; finite, non-negative.

matched_pairs.description: Count of pairs whose rounded receivable equals the rounded payable; null on the fail-closed path.

mismatched_pairs.description: Count of pairs with unequal rounded amounts.

elimination_total.description: Sum over all pairs of the smaller (eliminated) side, 2dp half-up.

mismatches.description: Mismatched pairs with their differences, declared order preserved.

trace.description: Full elimination and residual trace, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

overall.description: GAPS_FOUND when at least one pair mismatches.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_intercompany_elimination_netting
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes an intercompany elimination and netting summary from declared entity pairs: matched and mismatched pair counts, elimination total (sum of the smaller side of every pair), unmatched residual (sum of mismatch differences), the mismatch listing, and an overall GAPS_FOUND or ALL_MATCHED verdict. Matching arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs only: not legal advice, not an audit opinion, not a settlement instruction — nothing is posted or paid anywhere.

pairs.description: declared entity pairs with a, b, a_receivable, b_payable

source: authored by INTERCOMPANY-ELIM-BUILD-1 per INTERCOMPANY-ELIM-BUILD-SPEC.md. Scope positioning: a matching-arithmetic checker over caller-declared synthetic inputs, not legal advice, not an audit opinion, and not a settlement instruction; absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired. Rounding: 2 decimal places, half-up, declared in-kernel and in trace.
